description: Output specification for Noto Peninsula earthquake sequence characterization

mainshock.description: highest-magnitude event in the filtered sequence

largest_aftershock.description: highest-magnitude event occurring after the mainshock

analysis_fields.bath_law_delta: float — mainshock minus largest aftershock magnitude
analysis_fields.foreshock_count: integer — number of filtered events before the mainshock origin time
analysis_fields.mc: float — catalog completeness magnitude (Maximum Curvature method)
analysis_fields.a_value: float — log10(N) where N is events at or above Mc

omori.description: Modified Omori Law aftershock rate decay model parameters

analysis_fields.aftershock_zone_length_km: float — maximum pairwise Haversine distance among aftershock epicenters
analysis_fields.total_energy_joules: float — summed seismic energy via Gutenberg-Richter energy-magnitude relation
analysis_fields.mainshock_energy_fraction: float — mainshock energy divided by total sequence energy

interevent_distances.description: consecutive time-ordered event pairs, great-circle distances
